source_name: CBCG — Kontrolna funkcija (supervision function hub)
why_relevant: Hub describing licensing and approvals ('izdavanje dozvola i odobrenja') for credit institutions and financial-service providers; links onward to registers, supervised-entity lists and credit-register services. Best entry point for enumerating fit-and-proper artefacts.

source_name: CBCG — Banke u Crnoj Gori (useful links / bank website directory)
why_relevant: Regulator-maintained directory of the banks' own website addresses — the cheapest authoritative way to resolve each licensed bank to its current corporate domain, which is precisely the seed list this coverage cell needs and the thing most likely to go stale after a rebrand (e.g. Nova Banka to Adriatic Bank).

source_name: CBCG — Zapošljavanje (careers policy / channels page)
why_relevant: States explicitly where CBCG publishes vacancies — zzzcg.me, print media, cbcg.me, prekoveze.me, and its social accounts (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X). A single page that enumerates the whole recruitment-signal surface for this cell.

source_name: CBCG – Register of banks (per-bank entity records, EN + ME)
why_relevant: Regulator-maintained register giving the authoritative current list of Montenegrin banks, their foreign parents and licensed status — the actor map this cell needs to keep the foreign-parent watchlist complete as ownership changes (Hipotekarna→AikGroup, Addiko→possible NLB).

source_name: CBCG register of banks — 'Banks in Montenegro' useful-links page
why_relevant: Authoritative actor list (licensed banks and, elsewhere on the site, payment institutions) that anchors the LinkedIn cell: every registered entity should have its LinkedIn presence checked, and absence of a page is itself a finding.

source_name: Uprava za inspekcijske poslove / Agencija za zapošljavanje registry document (gov.me)
why_relevant: A government-hosted document concerning employment-agency licensing/registration. If it is (or leads to) the register of licensed employment-mediation agencies, it yields the authoritative list of private recruiters operating in Montenegro — the actor list needed to systematically cover the indirect agency channel identified above.

source_name: CRPS — Centralna evidencija stvarnih vlasnika (beneficial-ownership register)
why_relevant: Beneficial-ownership filings expose the real control structure behind PIs — critical here because the Montenegro Transfers / Alta Pay Group cluster and foreign-parented PIs (PaySpot ME under a Novi Sad parent) mean apparent org changes are often group-driven. Ownership shifts reliably precede management replacement.

source_name: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council (MFIC) - member profile pages (Payten and other vendors)
why_relevant: MFIC member profiles carry unusually concrete Montenegro-specific vendor facts: local headcount, number of ATMs/POS deployed, number of bank customers, year of market entry. It is also an actor map for which international suppliers actually have a registered Montenegrin presence, and members' representatives are named, which surfaces country-manager-level people.

source_name: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council (MFIC) — member list and board/leadership pages
why_relevant: Bank CEOs sit on the MFIC board; changes there (e.g. an MFIC president stepping down to take a new banking role) are a reliable indirect leadership-move signal, and MFIC posts these on LinkedIn.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — Montenegro bank profiles (management, ownership, market share)
why_relevant: Maintains English profiles of every licensed Montenegrin bank including ownership, market share and board composition — a convenient cross-check layer for the actor map, though derived rather than primary.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — Montenegro bank profiles (management/board sections)
why_relevant: Complete enumeration of the 11 licensed ME banks with per-bank profile pages; the canonical actor list to which every LinkedIn company page must be mapped, and it flags smaller banks (Ziraat, Zapad) easily missed.

source_name: AmCham Montenegro — member area / user registry
why_relevant: Member-company listing with contact persons; if it is public it enumerates AmCham's banking/payments/IT membership. Appears to be an account-gated area (a /register/ page exists), so likely partially restricted.

source_name: Tracxn — FinTech startups in Montenegro
why_relevant: Enumerates ~102 ME-linked fintech companies with funding status and team/competitor profiles; the most complete ready-made actor map for this cell, feeding downstream people-tracking.

source_name: Tracxn — payments startups in Montenegro (people/founder profiles)
why_relevant: Enumerates c.17 ME payments startups (PencePay, XCHPay.me, LocalPay, Sharej, 4On) — the non-bank PSP actor list whose LinkedIn pages and founder profiles then become trackable hiring/leadership sources.

source_name: 10times — Budva / Podgorica / Montenegro event listings
why_relevant: Global event aggregator with country/city pages that list upcoming Montenegrin business, banking and technology events with dates, venues and organiser links. Best used as a discovery net to catch new or one-off event brands before they are covered by local media, then snowball to the event's own speaker page.

source_name: AmChams in Europe — member chamber directory
why_relevant: Umbrella directory that confirms AmCham Montenegro's canonical domain and its leadership contacts, and provides a stable resolution point if the national chamber's site is restructured. Low direct value, useful as a resolver.

entity_name: Cbonds issuer profiles for Montenegrin banks
source_name: Cbonds issuer profiles for Montenegrin banks (e.g. Hipotekarna banka)
why_relevant: Aggregates issuer identifiers (LEI, SWIFT), rating history and news for Montenegrin banks in English — useful for entity resolution across IFI, rating and press sources, and for spotting rating actions that discuss management quality.

source_name: CompanyData.com / BoldData — Montenegro company database (CRPS-derived)
why_relevant: Bulk commercial dataset sourced from CRPS (~92k entities, 69k corporations as of mid-2026) with 50+ fields and API access — a way to obtain the full entity universe as a file rather than crawling the register.

source_name: Crnogorski edukativni Centar Podgorica — trainers page
why_relevant: Commercial training provider in Podgorica whose 'nasi predavaci' page names instructors with their professional affiliations; commercial trainers in finance/compliance in a market this small are frequently serving or former bank staff, so the roster is a cheap secondary title source and a lead list for who is training bank employees.

source_name: Dealroom — Montenegro ecosystem profile
why_relevant: Public 'taster' of ME startup ecosystem with founder pedigrees and team maps behind demo access; useful for identifying founders and C-level of ME-active fintechs and their moves between companies.

source_name: ETUI trade union profiles – Montenegro (USSCG and SSCG entries)
why_relevant: European Trade Union Institute directory profiling Montenegrin confederations, their affiliation and branch structure — the fastest route to the correct legal names of the finance/banking branch unions and their European affiliations (UNI Europa Finance).

source_name: HitHorizons — Montenegro company database
why_relevant: Pan-European registry aggregator covering Montenegrin entities; useful for cross-border parent/subsidiary resolution of foreign-owned Montenegrin banks (NLB, OTP/CKB, Erste-type groups).

source_name: Media Ownership Monitor Montenegro (Reporters Without Borders / partner)
why_relevant: A structured inventory of Montenegrin media outlets with ownership, reach and audience data. This is the authoritative pointer for completing and bias-weighting this cell's source list: it tells you which portals exist, who owns them, and therefore whose reporting on a contested bank dismissal is likely to be politically motivated. Directly supplies the credibility priors used above.

source_name: Nacionalni biro osiguravača Crne Gore (NBOCG) — National Bureau of Insurers, members and assembly
why_relevant: Mandatory-membership body for all insurers in Montenegro; its Skupština president rotates among insurer CEOs (Matjaž Božić observed as assembly president c.2022). Because 'sector=both' includes bancassurance-linked payments and because NBOCG sits on the Chamber banking board, its member list and assembly elections extend the actor map to the insurance side.

source_name: Portal pravosuđa Crne Gore (pravosudje.me)
why_relevant: Umbrella judiciary portal pointing to individual courts, case-tracking services and judicial statistics — the navigation layer for finding which court hears labour disputes against banks in a given municipality.

entity_name: Sindikat uprave i pravosuđa Crne Gore
source_name: Sindikat uprave i pravosuđa Crne Gore (branch union site, AMRRS coverage)
why_relevant: Example of an active Montenegrin branch-union website that reports on AMRRS and dispute practice; serves as a template and pointer for locating the equivalent finance/banking branch union site and its publication habits.

source_name: StartupBlink — Podgorica / Montenegro ecosystem pages
why_relevant: Free ranked listing of ME/Podgorica startups; low-cost cross-check on which fintech startups are still active and where secondary hubs (Nikšić, Bar) are emerging.
